Questions and Statements by Council Members
Councillor Seguin requested the status of the Short Term Rental Policy.  Ms. Beggs stated that a report was brought to Council in February 2026 which outlined the STR regulatory framework subject to a business plan being developed at budget time.  A statutory public meeting was held on both the official plan and the zoning by-law amendment.  As part of the 2027 budget deliberations, a business plan will be presented outlining all the outstanding resources which will be required to implement the program. Councillor Seguin asked if the plan will include a compliance component.  Ms. Beggs stated that the business plan will outline the resources and operational needs that are required to implement the program, along with the timeline of roles & responsibilities of the STR regulatory by-law.  That will not be started until supporting resources for implementation are known.
Councillor Riccio-Spagnuolo requested an update on the completion of the pickleball courts.  J. Osborne stated that the majority of the work will be done by the end of this construction season.  He further advised the only outstanding item is the surfacing of the courts which is temperature-dependent and is projected to be done in spring 2027.
